text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
In order to preheat the air and to
avoid acid corrosion on the cold layers of the regenerative air preheater when
firing fuel oil two steam oil air heaters are arranged
in FD fans delivery ducts they are designed to utilize auxiliary saturated
steam at 7Kg/cm2 press. (Steam air heater: 2 per unit)
As heating medium the steam coil preheater
consisting of series of finned tubes connected to headers and are fed by steam
coming from auxiliary steam heater the steam air preheater are dimensioned so
that the air entering to the regenerative air heater is heated 80 AS to
maintain const the cold end arrange temp. Intended as the 
arithmetic
mean between the flue gas exit temperature
{Uncorrected for air leakage} and the air inlet temperature.
The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.
This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
earplugs etc.
Isolate the dampers.
Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
earplugs etc.
Isolate the dampers.
Tools and Equipment
Standard mechanical tool
 set fire shoes
Special equipments for
 pumping water to check the tubes of the steam air-heater
Work
to be Carried Out
Inspect steam coil for leakage by
hydrostatic test by pressurized water into tubes & steam air heater, repair if there is leak electrodes 101B enconel
 NICR1B2
Clean tube fine if dust by pressurized water or by air
~ 6-7 kg/Cm2
Change all gaskets
Inspect all steam traps and change the internal parts if needed.
